item.title: Water authorities warn: Flushing frying fat causes sewer blockages, millions in costs
item.description: Dutch water authorities are urging residents not to pour frying fat or oil down sinks or toilets during the New Year period, citing recurring sewer blockages and expensive treatment costs.

item.title: Winter weather warning: snow, ice, 90 km/h gusts across Netherlands this weekend

item.title: Animal ambulances dispatched 150 times over New Year’s
item.description: The Dutch Animal Protection received over 300 reports of missing or injured animals around New Year’s, including 34 on New Year’s Eve, a slight increase from last year.

item.title: Targeted measures lead to significant decline in Dutch medicine shortages
item.description: Medicine shortages have eased considerably in 2025, dropping by about a third compared with 2024, according to a report from healthcare consultancy SiRM.
